description: NaBiSe₂ is Caswellsilverite structured and crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3m space group. Na¹⁺ is bonded to six equivalent Se²⁻ atoms to form NaSe₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent BiSe₆ octahedra, edges with six equivalent NaSe₆ octahedra, and edges with six equivalent BiSe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 2°. All Na-Se bond lengths are 3.04 Å. Bi³⁺ is bonded to six equivalent Se²⁻ atoms to form BiSe₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaSe₆ octahedra, edges with six equivalent NaSe₆ octahedra, and edges with six equivalent BiSe₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 2°. All Bi-Se bond lengths are 2.95 Å. Se²⁻ is bonded to three equivalent Na¹⁺ and three equivalent Bi³⁺ atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SeNa₃Bi₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted.
